create.name: Julie Murphy
create.bio:
Julie Murphy, who publishes as Yogaressa, is a Florida-based teacher whose work centres on Yoga Nidra, the guided practice of 'yogic sleep'. She spent many years as a technology executive working across Africa, Europe and the United States, where yoga and meditation kept her steady. She began teaching in 2007, the same year a first teacher training in Austin, Texas, introduced her to Yoga Nidra. Later studies took her to an Anusara immersion in Sarasota, a 300-hour training at a school in McLeod Ganj in northern India, the Divine Sleep method with Jennifer Reis, and a 200-hour Yoga Nidra immersion with Swami Yogaratna at an ashram in Gokarna, rooted in the Satyananda tradition.

She presents Yoga Nidra as more than a way to drift off: a structured journey through the layers of awareness, guided by a heartfelt intention, or sankalpa, that can open the way to insight and change. Her free recordings on Insight Timer reach a large audience, and her albums are on streaming services. For students who want to go further she runs a self-study Yoga Nidra Essentials programme and a 35-hour certification, both recognised for Yoga Alliance continuing education. Since 2015 she has also co-led small yoga and meditation retreats with her friend Karen in countries including Costa Rica, Guatemala, India, Italy, Peru and South Africa.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra Essentials
courses.description: A self-paced home-study programme that builds on her popular Insight Timer Yoga Nidra series. Alongside the audio it adds video lessons, summary sheets for each module, a glossary, journaling prompts and a practice log, for beginners and teachers alike.

courses.title: Yoga Nidra Teacher Training (35-hour certification)
courses.description: A 35-hour training covering what Yoga Nidra is, how its stages fit together and how to guide it for others, with personal practice throughout. It is open to non-teachers who simply want to deepen their own practice and counts towards Yoga Alliance continuing education.

free_resources.title: Julie Murphy on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Insight Timer page gathers hundreds of free guided recordings, mostly Yoga Nidra and body-scan practices, along with affirmation and chakra meditations. Anyone can listen without charge.

free_resources.title: Yoga Nidra sample tracks
free_resources.description: A short page for newcomers explaining how to approach Yoga Nidra when sitting in silence feels hard, with free audio samples from her albums to try at home.
